footnotes:
The figures “MV160G” may relate to the date of the instrument, but their significance is unclear. The last figure may
or may not be a G. It resembles a letter “C” with a small vertical stroke resting on the bottom of the arc. As Waterhouse
says that Reuter lived 1604-61, the date of “1660ca” is an educated guess.
